messages:
rachel: spotted repeated small-gen microbursts on rack-r12 (us-east-1) over the last 15m. PCIe util bouncing 75-90% during bursts and NIC tx queues grow. tails for 0-16 token requests up ~80ms.

 tom: any tenant hotspot id? is this similar to the deepviz noisy tenant pattern? link?

 rachel: topFlow shows tenant=kline_ai high rps with median tokens 6. here's perf pane: https://o11y.redwood/flows?k=tenant:kline_ai&from=-20m

 ops-bot: alert: rack-r12 PCIe util > 80% for 10m, sustained per-tenant small-req-rate > 250rps (auto-ticket 71234).

 liam: could be tiny-req pattern where batching never forms and we hit PCIe DMA overhead. we prototyped a tiny-req detector last quarter (`tiny_req_classifier`) — should we flip it to route into a hotlane? low-latency nodes can favor low batch sizes but cost more.

 esther: careful — kline_ai is on a paid dedicated fractional slice. we can't route them to different capacity without notifying billing / PM. SLA implications.

 tom: proposal: enable autodetect canary for this tenant only: if `tiny_req_classifier` sees >200rps small-req for 3m, annotate requests with `route=hotlane-canary` and observe latency. no hard move, just routing decision in proxy.

 rachel: i can enable the canary for kline_ai on rack-r12 for 30m. it's non-invasive and reversible. CLI snippet:

 ```
 # enable tiny-req canary for tenant kline_ai on rack-r12
 TENANT=kline_ai
 HOST=rack-r12
 curl -X POST https://infra-api/route/canary -d '{"host":"'$HOST'","tenant":"'$TENANT'","policy":"tiny-req-hotlane","ttl":"30m"}'
 ```

 liam: small note: hotlane nodes are quantized (8-bit kernels) and warm kv-cache. should verify model variant compatibility (quantized vs fp16) before routing.

 esther: add billing/tag header: `x-mitigation-tag: tiny-hotlane/5110000000` so finance-beth can estimate delta.

 finance-beth: i'll run a back-of-envelope: hotlane runrate + expected extra infra cost per-hour. we need to pass cost to account when this becomes persistent.

 tom: follow-ups: 1) rachel run canary & paste o11y link 2) liam produce detector PR to make threshold configurable 3) infra add auto-annotate header for billing 4) pm to contact kline_ai if persistent (esther)

 rachel: starting canary now. watching metrics and will post results in 15m.

 ops-bot: ticket 71234 updated: canary enabled for tenant=kline_ai by rachel at 5110000025. next review 5110000185.

 rachel: initial 5m: PCIe tails down ~25%, p99 latency for small-reqs down 45ms. small positive signal. will keep the canary running and escalate to policy if sustained.

 liam: if stable, next step is opt-in hotlane via billing+consent or a negotiated slice bump. otherwise we need better KV cache hinting SDKs to reduce tiny-reqs.

 esther: thanks. save runbook steps and add an entry to noisy-tenant playbook for hotlane canary.
